style.name: Japandi Deco
style.definition: Japanese restraint with a few geometric Deco accents and a richer material contrast.
style.materials: dark walnut; ivory linen; muted jade; bronze; pale stone
style.living: ivory low straight sofa; muted-jade rounded chair; pale oval stone coffee table with bronze base; dark walnut media cabinet; compact walnut table with four jade upholstered chairs; opal and bronze globe pendant; one restrained fan-pattern rug
style.bed: dark walnut low queen with gently curved jade headboard; ivory bedding; walnut nightstands and bronze opal lamps
style.solarium: dark teak outdoor seating with jade performance pads; teak dining table with bronze-tone metal chairs
style.implement: Limit Deco to one fan motif and bronze detailing so the Japanese restraint remains legible.
